setup:
@c1 command action=create shape=rectangle name=Room color=gray fill=none layer=zone width=700 height=420 at=400,250
@c2 command action=create shape=rectangle name=Door label="Main door" color=brown position=bottom anchor=Room
text: Two round tables to start. One each side.
Left one is family, right one friends.
Family needs eight chairs.
Six round the friends one for now.
Put Mum nearest the door at the family table.
Dad opposite her.
Jo beside Dad. no, beside Mum
Sam next to Jo.
Can you put the actual names on the chairs? Just the four we have.
Auntie Pat goes by Dad, with Len on her other side.
How many empty seats at family now?
Give the last two to Noor and Ellis.
Friends: Bea, Kit, Mo, Ash, Dev, Lou. Clockwise from the top.
Those two tables look a bit close for Mum to get her walker through.
A little more gap, yeah.
Small rectangle at the far end for the cake.
Sent that to Jo. She can deal with the politics now.
Mic on the left.
Call it AT2020.
Cable from that into the Scarlett. Input 1.
Headphones below the red box.
Connect those to the Scarlett too.
Stereo speakers above the laptop, two little boxes.
Left one L, right one R.
Both fed from the Scarlett.
Add a keyboard under the mic. MIDI keyboard I mean, not a typing one.
USB straight to laptop for that.
Can the audio cables be orange?
Keep USB grey.
The headphone wire runs right through the keyboard now. Take it round underneath.
Which things are plugged into the laptop?
Dashed box round the two speakers, labelled borrowed.
Actually lose the speakers and that box. Headphones only tonight.
Bigger writing on Input 1. I need to read this from the floor.
Three long beds across the middle.
Top to bottom: beans, carrots, squash.
Leave a walking gap between each.
Water butt next to shed. Blue circle.
Name it Butt so I can find it.
Hose from tap to beans.
Branch off that for carrots.
No hose to squash yet.
Put a little valve where the branch starts.
Valve should be red. Sorry orange, red means broken on our other plan.
Can you show which bed still has no water?
Line from Butt to squash, dotted. Thats the watering can trip.
Write hand watered beside squash.
Move the shed a touch right, the butt is sitting in the path.
Fence along the left edge.
Gap in it opposite carrots for the gate.
Add a note at the bottom: shut tap before leaving.
